title: Gel Diode vs Standard Laser Hair Removal in Dubai
h1: Gel diode vs standard laser hair removal: which one to choose
desc: Gel diode vs standard laser hair removal at Skin & Laser Dubai: how the machines differ, comfort, results, and prices from AED 70 + VAT (gel diode) and AED 50 + VAT.
answer: Both machines remove hair long term by heating the follicle; the difference is the menu and the feel. Our gel diode uses a cooling gel and has its own lower prices for large areas, for example full body without front and back at AED 350 + VAT, or AED 250 + VAT per session in a 6-session package. Our standard menu uses Smartitrion-Q and diode lasers chosen by skin type, from AED 50 + VAT for small areas, with 3 and 6-session packages.
facts: Gel diode, full body (no front/back), 6 sessions
body:
## How they differ

Both are lasers that target the pigment in the hair and disable the follicle, and both need 6 to 8 sessions about 4 to 6 weeks apart. The [gel diode](/treatments/gel-diode-laser-hair-removal-dubai/) is a separate diode machine used with a thin layer of cooling gel, which helps the handpiece glide over large areas and keeps the skin surface cool. The [standard menu](/treatments/laser-hair-removal-dubai/) uses Smartitrion-Q and diode lasers, and the doctor chooses the laser and settings for your skin type.

## Prices side by side

- **Underarms:** gel diode AED 70 + VAT; standard AED 100 + VAT
- **Full legs:** gel diode AED 300 + VAT; standard AED 350 + VAT
- **Full body (without front and back):** gel diode AED 350 + VAT; standard AED 499 + VAT
- **Full body (all areas):** gel diode AED 450 + VAT; standard AED 550 + VAT
- **Small face areas:** standard from AED 50 + VAT

Gel diode 6-session packages bring the price down further, for example full legs at AED 150 + VAT per session (AED 900 + VAT in total). The standard menu has 3 and 6-session packages too.

## Which one to choose

- **Large body areas on a budget:** the gel diode usually gives the lowest total, especially in a 6-session package.
- **Face, small areas and beard shaping:** the standard menu has the small-area prices and the most precise options.
- **Darker skin or very sensitive skin:** your doctor chooses the laser and settings that are safest for your skin type, which is often on the standard menu. See [laser hair removal for dark skin](/blog/laser-hair-removal-dark-skin-dubai/).

## Comfort

Most people feel a warm snap with either machine. The cooling gel makes the gel diode feel smooth over large areas; the standard lasers have built-in cooling. Neither needs numbing for most areas.

## Before and after

The preparation is the same for both: shave 12 to 24 hours before, avoid waxing, threading or epilating for 4 weeks, and stay out of the sun. Read the [preparation guide](/blog/laser-hair-removal-preparation-guide/) and [aftercare](/blog/laser-hair-removal-aftercare/), or compare full costs in [laser hair removal cost in Dubai](/blog/laser-hair-removal-cost-dubai/).

faq: Is the gel diode less effective?
No. Both remove hair long term; most people need 6 to 8 sessions either way.
For large body areas the gel diode is usually cheaper, especially in a 6-session package.
Can I switch machines during a course?
Ask your doctor; it is usually best to finish a course on one machine so settings stay consistent.
